mg.title: The WRAP line

text.main: I took the Wellness Recovery Action Plan

mg.use: Only after the name super is gone, from 00:11. One text at a time.

mg.title: Resilience and stamina
mg.use: Each word lands on his voice, in the top band. Stay on his face under it.

mg.title: Focus on Coti
mg.use: Brackets around his face while he tells his own story. Not at the same time as MG2.

mg.title: Safe and vulnerable

text.main: it's the only place I feel safe and vulnerable.

mg.use: After the 2 s top text is gone. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Terrapin Station tag
mg.src: Shoot location in the transcript header (Terrapin Station, Omaha).
mg.use: Small, upper left, at the start of the row. Not at the same time as MG6.

mg.title: Pull them along

text.main: reach my hand behind me and pull these guys along with me

mg.use: Over his face during the slow push-in, as he says it. Keep captions on.

mg.title: It's real

text.main: it's real. I keep coming back to it.

mg.use: Full-frame cutaway on “it's real”, only if the OCC B-roll is not cleared. Not at the same time as MG4.

mg.title: Keep on going back

text.main: I'm going to keep on going back and trying to help them the best I can.

mg.use: Only after the hook text goes out at 00:04.5, as he says it. Never on frame 1. Keep captions on.

note: The plan says stay on his face for his own story and let the last line sit, so nothing goes on the button. Prefer the top overlays; use the full-frame cards only if Nick asks for more.
